Class Abilities

1st Level — Class Skills

All of the following abilities are gained at 1st level. Each uses the associated attribute for checks.

Death Attack

  • Effect: Study a target for 3 full rounds without being detected; studying is your action each round, and it ends if the target can see you or you attack. Must attack within 3 rounds of completing study, and a Death Attack can only be delivered by a Sneak Attack against a target that cannot see you.
  • On a successful Sneak Attack that deals damage: target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC, or dies instantly. Death Attack works only on a target whose Level does not exceed your Assassin level plus 2
  • Save succeeds: attack deals the maximum on its Sneak Attack dice instead
  • If the Assassin is detected while studying, the study is voided and must begin again
  • A missed attack resets the 3-round study requirement

Sneak Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (see the Assassin Progression Table) against an aware-but-unsuspecting target.
  • Usable once per round.
  • A target is unsuspecting if it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you.
  • Usable at range within 30ft
  • No prior stealth check required
  • A Death Attack is delivered by a Sneak Attack; if the target saves, it takes maximum Sneak Attack dice damage

Killer's Precision

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage per three Assassin levels (minimum +1). This applies to every hit, not only Sneak Attacks.

Assassin's Skills

  • Effect: Each skill below is a check using its associated attribute, with the notes listed. Hide and Move Silently count as Stealth, and Listen as Perception, for kits, feats and other features.
  • Case Target (Wisdom): Spend 1d3×10 minutes observing a target. On a successful check:
    • Learn its approximate Level
    • Learn its Allegiance (most mortals are Unaligned)
    • Identify hidden weapons or unusual items
    • Note distinguishing habits and mannerisms
    • GM adjusts for target's power
  • Climb (Dexterity): Scale any surface — walls, ceilings, unusual angles, man-made or natural — at half speed.
    • Failed check: no progress
    • Failed by 5+: fall
    • Cannot carry anything in hand while climbing
  • Disguise (Charisma): Disguise self or impersonate others (1d3×10 minutes for a general disguise; 1 month for a specific individual).
    • Apparent height/weight change limited to one-tenth of original
    • GM rolls secretly.
  • GM adjusts: the more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Hide (Dexterity): Conceal yourself from observers; you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
    • Half speed or slower: no penalty
    • Above half speed: disadvantage
    • Running: impossible
    • Cannot hide if being casually observed
    • If an observer is momentarily distracted: attempt at disadvantage — must move quickly to hiding spot
    • Nothing to hide behind: cannot attempt
  • Identify Poison (Intelligence): Identify any poison or antitoxin on a successful check.
    • Create poisons or antitoxins with alchemical equipment and raw materials — cost equals one-third of street value
    • Assassins never risk accidental poisoning when applying poison to a blade
    • Gains +1 to poison saves at 3rd level
  • Listen (Wisdom): Hear sounds others might miss.
    • Whispers or soft movement up to 30ft in open air, or through an adjacent door
    • Through stone wall: disadvantage
    • Other materials vary — GM discretion
    • Retryable once per round
  • Move Silently (Dexterity): Move without sound indoors or outdoors.
    • Half speed or slower: no penalty
    • Above half speed: disadvantage
    • Running: impossible
    • From 3rd level: attempt both at disadvantage on both checks, at quarter speed.
  • Traps (Intelligence): Find, disable, or set traps.
    • Find: 1 round for a specific area, 1 minute for a 10×10ft area
    • Disable: 1 minute; failing by 5 or more, or rolling a natural 1, sets it off (see Traps)
    • Set or reset: 1d4 rounds — resetting a previously disabled trap gains +5
    • Can find magical traps — GM determines penalty

2nd Level

Quiet Kill

  • Effect: A creature you reduce to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack makes no sound as it falls. Nearby creatures get no check to notice the kill by sound alone.

3rd Level

Ambush Predator

  • Effect: In the first round of combat, creatures that have not yet acted count as unsuspecting for your Sneak Attack.

4th Level

Poisoner's Edge

  • Effect: A poison you apply to a weapon lasts for 3 hits instead of 1, and its save DC is 2 higher.

6th Level

Marked Prey

  • Effect: After a successful Case Target check, you have Advantage on checks to track or tail that target for 24 hours, and Death Attack study against it takes only 2 rounds.

7th Level

Lethal Dose

  • Effect: The first hit each fight with a poisoned weapon also deals +1d6 poison damage. The target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC to negate the extra damage.

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Sneak Attack still applies to only one attack per round.

8th Level

Many Faces

  • Effect: A general disguise takes 5 minutes, and a disguise as a specific individual takes 1 week instead of a month.

9th Level

Shadow Step

  • Effect: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack, you may move up to 15ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

10th Level

Venom Tolerance

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against poison.

12th Level

Finishing Blow

  • Effect: A Sneak Attack against a creature at half its HP or less deals maximum damage on its damage dice.

13th Level

Surprise

  • Effect: Targets suffer -1 to their passive awareness against the assassin's ambush. Improves to -2 at 18th and -3 at 23rd.

14th Level

Reaper's Reach

  • Effect: You can Cleave with any attack, not only a melee weapon, and a Cleave attack can be a Sneak Attack.

15th Level

Dexterity Bonus

  • Effect: Gain a permanent +1 to Dexterity.

Signature Style

  • Effect: Choose one type of attack, poison, or tactic used throughout your career.
  • When executing a Death Attack using this signature style, the target's Fortitude save DC is 2 higher than the standard Death Attack DC.

17th Level

Unerring Edge

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack ignores resistance to physical damage (not immunity).

18th Level

  • Quick Reaction: gain +1 to all initiative rolls

19th Level

Perfect Study

  • Effect: Death Attack study takes only 1 round, and a missed attack no longer resets it.

20th Level

Slow Kill

  • Effect: On a successful hit, the target takes normal weapon damage. Each subsequent round they lose 1d6 HP from blood loss unless healed or bandaged.
  • Bleeding is cumulative
  • Only usable before the target has acted this encounter
  • Maximum four Slow Kill strikes on a single target per encounter — after four hits all vulnerable areas have been struck
  • Works with Sneak Attack simultaneously

21st Level

Marked for Death

  • Effect: A target you have marked with Marked Prey makes its Death Attack save with Disadvantage.

24th Level

Quick Reaction (Improved)

  • Effect: +2 to all initiative rolls.
  • On a natural 11+ initiative result, gain one extra action at end of round — attack or half-movement only

Slow Kill (Improved)

  • Effect: Wounds caused by Slow Kill heal at half rate — even magical healing is halved.
  • A successful Slow Kill blow may incapacitate a limb — assassin's choice
  • Target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC, or loses use of that limb until healed
  • Does not work on non-bleeding creatures

Kits: Assassin Guilds and Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Assassin folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines your guild, tradition, and the network you belong to — or fled from.
